hook_text: Late night emergency call handled instantly

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good evening, after-hours dispatch line for Aura Salon & Spa.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Greetings, my name is Tarun. We have an unexpected breakdown requiring Emergency Same-Day Priority Slot.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Rest assured, we handle after-hours calls twenty-four-seven. Opening a priority ticket for our master stylist.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: What is the fastest arrival window you can offer in our area?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We have an expedited 8:30 AM window with our master stylist Kavita reserved for you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Will the technician call me when they are on the road?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have captured your phone number and address. Stand by for an immediate SMS tracker.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Phew, what a relief. Thanks for answering so late!
